rice.name: Rice
rice.desc: Requires high moisture and warm temperatures. Highly suited for clayey soils with high water retention.

maize.name: Maize
maize.desc: Thrives in well-drained fertile soils with moderate rainfall and warm sunshine.

chickpea.name: Chickpea
chickpea.desc: Leguminous crop excellent for nitrogen fixation. Thrives in cooler, drier climates.

kidneybeans.name: Kidney Beans
kidneybeans.desc: Requires well-aerated soil rich in organic nutrients with moderate moisture levels.

pigeonpeas.name: Pigeon Peas
pigeonpeas.desc: Drought-tolerant pulse crop that enhances soil fertility through deep root penetration.

mothbeans.name: Moth Beans
mothbeans.desc: Exceptionally drought-resistant, perfect for arid soil profiles with low nitrogen levels.

mungbean.name: Mung Bean
mungbean.desc: Short-duration crop suited for warm seasonal rotation in loamy soil.

blackgram.name: Black Gram
blackgram.desc: Thrives in heavier soils; provides natural soil cover and organic enrichment.

lentil.name: Lentil
lentil.desc: Prefers well-drained loamy soil with neutral pH balance and cold-to-moderate weather.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate
pomegranate.desc: High-value fruit crop suitable for semi-arid conditions and well-drained soils.

banana.name: Banana
banana.desc: Heavy feeder requiring rich organic potassium, high humidity, and abundant water.

mango.name: Mango
mango.desc: Deep-rooted perennial crop performing best in warm tropical climates with well-drained soil.

grapes.name: Grapes
grapes.desc: Requires well-drained soil with ideal micro-nutrients and dry warm ripening periods.

watermelon.name: Watermelon
watermelon.desc: Thrives in warm sandy loam soil with full sun exposure and balanced irrigation.

muskmelon.name: Muskmelon
muskmelon.desc: Requires sunny, warm weather and well-drained sandy soil profiles.

apple.name: Apple
apple.desc: Temperate fruit crop performing best in cooler highland climates with loamy soil.

orange.name: Orange
orange.desc: Citrus crop preferring well-drained sandy loam with moderate humidity.

papaya.name: Papaya
papaya.desc: Fast-growing tropical crop requiring rich organic matter and zero waterlogging.

coconut.name: Coconut
coconut.desc: Coastal tropical palm thriving in high humidity, saline resilience, and heavy rainfall.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.desc: Commercial cash crop thriving in deep black cotton soils with sunny dry conditions.

jute.name: Jute
jute.desc: Fiber crop requiring alluvial soil, high ambient temperature, and heavy monsoon rain.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.desc: Shade-loving plantation crop requiring acidic, organic-rich soil and cool hill weather.
